name: Synthetic fixture: TRAPPIST-1 f (real archive values)

radius_rjup.source: synthetic fixture: real TRAPPIST-1 f value, NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_rade (Agol et al. 2021, 2021PSJ.....2....1A), 1.045 Earth radii converted to Jupiter radii (x 6378.1366 km / 71492 km)

teq_K.source: synthetic fixture: real TRAPPIST-1 f value, NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_eqt (Ducrot et al. 2020, 2020A&A...640A.112D)
teq_K.formula: Teq = T_star * sqrt(R_star / (2a)) * (1 - A)^(1/4), as computed in the cited paper
teq_K.assumption: the cited paper's own albedo and heat redistribution; an equilibrium temperature, not a measured one (#93 3.5)
